This plot is small but important for my family, so I will spread manure from our animals and a little bit of chemical fertilizer to make sure the plants grow well. I have kept seeds from my own harvest for this crop, so I do not need to buy new ones from the market. Since the plot is just next to our home, my children and I can take care of all the planting, weeding, and harvesting without hiring anyone. We depend on the rain because there is no water pump or canal here, and I do not have money for sprays, so we will pull the weeds by hand.
